stripePaymentIntentId.description: Unique Stripe Payment Intent ID from Stripe API

amount.description: Payment amount in decimal format (converted to cents by Stripe)

status.description: Payment status reflecting the current state of the Payment Intent

customerEmail.description: Customer email address for payment confirmation

metadata.description: Flexible JSON metadata to store application-specific identifiers (e.g., orderId)

completedAt.description: Timestamp when payment was marked as succeeded

errorMessage.description: Error message stored when payment fails (from Stripe error response)
